name: Data grid (categorized sub-grids, hideable columns, expandable rows)
description: A grid of rows grouped into categories and sub-categories, each group with its own header, totals and progress meter. Columns hide and show from the header's context menu or a chooser, sort from the header, rows expand into a detail panel, rows carry a status edge, and rows / groups drag to rearrange or onto lib-dnd's trash can. Harvested Oct 22 2026 from Walkthrough Studio's status grid. Every grid is also a dataset (datasets.ts, Oct 28 2026): plugins attach filters, sorts and a toolbar above it without the view knowing them. Row hooks (grid-hook@1, Oct 29 2026): a grid says what each row is (rowRef → { kind, id }) and plugins add a row button + a right-click item for that kind without the grid naming them. Row kinds (grid-row@1, Nov 12 2026, rowkinds.ts + rowdetail.tsx): a screen registers a kind of record once (fields, related-link resolvers, commands) and every row of that kind expands into every field, Related links that open in place and its commands (row buttons, right-click, multi-select bar), each command also the console action row.<kind>.<command> for control@1 (API, MCP, CLI, voice).

parts.label: Categorized sub-grids
parts.description: Rows grouped under category headers (folding, totals, a meter per group).

parts.label: Hideable columns
parts.description: Right-click (or long-press) a column header to hide it or pick columns; a chooser dialog for everything.

parts.label: Sort by column
parts.description: Tap a header to sort inside each group; again to reverse, a third time for the original order.

parts.label: Expandable rows
parts.description: A chevron, a tap or double-tap opens the row: the screen's detail, Commands, Related links (open in place) and every field (grid-row@1).

parts.label: Drag rows
parts.description: Rows and groups drag to rearrange, or onto the trash can (needs lib-dnd).

params.label: Deleting by dropping on the trash can
